meaning:
δανίζω
(late form of cl. -είζω, Rec., Bl., § 3; Thackeray, Gr., 85f.) [in LXX chiefly for לוה (Pro.19:17) ;]
to lend money on interest: Luk.6:34, 35; mid., to borrow: Mat.5:42.†
SYN.: κίχρημι (see: χράω), to lend in a friendly way. (AS)

elsewhere.note: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.
